description: Goan Fish Curry is a vibrant and aromatic dish from the coastal state of Goa, India, renowned for its rich blend of spices and creamy coconut base. This delightful curry features tender pieces of fresh fish simmered in a tangy gravy infused with red chilies, kokum, and a medley of authentic Indian spices. It perfectly balances heat, tang, and sweetness, offering a truly unforgettable culinary experience that transports you straight to the sunny beaches of Goa.

ingredients.notes: cleaned, cut into 2-inch pieces, marinated with 1/2 tsp turmeric and salt
soaked in warm water for 15 minutes

instructions.title: Prepare the Masala Paste
instructions.text: Drain the soaked red chilies. In a grinder, combine the soaked chilies, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, black peppercorns, fenugreek seeds, turmeric powder, garlic cloves, ginger, and tamarind pulp (if using). Add a little water if needed and grind to a very smooth paste. Set aside.

instructions.title: Temper the Spices
instructions.text: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pan or earthen pot over medium heat. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter. Then add the curry leaves and sauté for a few seconds until fragrant.

instructions.title: Cook the Onion
instructions.text: Add the finely chopped onion to the pan and sauté until it turns translucent and light golden brown, about 5-7 minutes. Ensure it is cooked well to form a good base for the curry.

instructions.title: Add Masala Paste
instructions.text: Add the prepared smooth masala paste to the pan. Cook the paste on low to medium heat for 8-10 minutes, stirring continuously, until the oil separates from the masala and the raw smell disappears. This step is crucial for flavor development.

instructions.title: Simmer with Coconut Milk and Kokum
instructions.text: Pour in the thick coconut milk and 1/2 cup of water. Add the soaked kokum pieces along with their soaking water (if using). Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, stirring occasionally to prevent the coconut milk from curdling. Season with salt to taste.

instructions.title: Add Fish and Cook
instructions.text: Gently slide the marinated fish pieces into the simmering curry. Ensure the fish is submerged in the gravy. Cook on low heat for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily. Avoid overcooking the fish to maintain its tenderness.

instructions.title: Final Touches and Serve
instructions.text: Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves if desired. Serve the authentic Goan Fish Curry hot with steamed rice or Goan pao (bread).

tips: For an authentic taste, always use fresh, thick coconut milk. Canned coconut milk works, but fresh yields a richer flavor.
Kokum provides a unique tangy flavor specific to Goan cuisine. If unavailable, use tamarind paste, but add it sparingly to avoid overpowering the delicate fish flavor.
Do not stir the curry vigorously after adding the fish, as this can break the delicate fish pieces. Gently swirl the pan or use a very light hand.
